responsibility: This file implements x_ruler, the text-art component for drawing labeled horizontal range rulers above or below annotated regions. It manages label collection, computes non-overlapping layout for label text and optional bordered labels, and paints themed ruler edges, connectors, vertical stems, and labels onto a canvas using theme cell kinds and style ids; it also contains extensive selftests covering adjacency, overlap, styling, borders, and emoji-width cases.
same_name_distinction: Implements x_ruler layout and painting, including connector placement, border drawing, and selftests; unlike gcc/text-art/ruler.h, it is the algorithmic rendering and layout definition rather than the class declaration.
